description: Official hosted MCP server for the Magic Hour AI video and image generation API: generate video (Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Seedance, MiniMax, WAN 2.2, LTX) and images (GPT-image, Nano Banana Pro, Seedream, Flux), plus face swap, lip sync, talking photo, and voice generation, with upload and job status/wait tools.

notes: OAuth for Claude connectors; bearer API key for other MCP clients

clients: and other MCP clients supporting Streamable HTTP
